name_en: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme - Tamil Nadu
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: You get Rs 1,000 every month. You also get a free saree or dhoti at Pongal and Deepavali, and free rice at the Anganwadi centre.

other: You must be destitute (no one to support you).
Your family must be in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) group.

documents: Smart ration card or any address proof
Any ID proof (voter ID, passport, PAN card or driving licence)
how_to_apply: Get copies of your papers. Go to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC). Give your fingerprint there. Fill the form and upload your papers. Ask for a receipt.

evidence.quote: launched by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
One free dhoti to a male pensioner.
One free saree to a female pensioner.
The applicant's age should be 60 years and above.
The applicant should belong to the "Below Poverty Line" category.
Smart Ration Card or Any Address Proof.
Any Identity Proof (Voter ID Card, Passport, PAN Card, Driving License).
visit the nearest Common Service Center (CSC) and complete the Biometric Verification Process.
Request a receipt or acknowledgment from the concerned authority
